# pve_vzdump_extractconfig (Data Source)

Extract the guest configuration stored in a vzdump backup archive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_vzdump_extractconfig" "example" {
node = "pve1"
volume = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `volume` (String) Volume identifier

### Read-Only

- `config` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
